content_blocks.title: Project Creation Form UI
content_blocks.content: A web form interface for creating a new project. Contains: (1) A 'Project image' upload area accepting PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF up to 10 MB. (2) A 'Name' text field with placeholder 'e.g. Ribosome Engineering'. (3) A 'Description' text area (0/500 characters) with placeholder 'What is this project about?' and helper text 'A one-paragraph summary. You can edit this later from settings.' (4) A 'Create project' button. Footer note: 'By creating this project, an assignment agreement is generated to govern your IP across the data room. You also agree to the Terms of Service.' No scientific or project-specific data has been entered.
